messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync 4: Cumulus Instruments POC ready but procurement insists invoice must come from "Redwood Inference UK Ltd". MSA on file names Redwood US Inc. They also attached a short SIG-lite security questionnaire and asked whether we can offer a prepaid POC credit on a VAT reverse-charge basis. Timeline: start in 10 days. @julia_legal @matt_finance @noah_solutions

julia_legal: We can handle this with a 1-page "billing designation addendum". Options: (A) execute OF under Redwood UK Ltd and link it to the US MSA via an express linking clause, or (B) keep MSA as-is and have UK issue invoice as an agent with an intercompany memo. Option A is cleaner for procurement. Need KYC for Cumulus UK entity and to review the SIG answers. Also, VAT reverse-charge requires customer VAT validation.

matt_finance: Finance: if billing = Redwood UK, invoices must use our UK bank and include UK VAT regs if applicable. For reverse-charge we need customer's VAT validation (VIES check) and the invoice formatted per HMRC guidance. Prepaid credit is doable but will be treated as deferred revenue until consumed. Confirm currency GBP or EUR.

noah_solutions: Delivery note: POC will ingest sensor telemetry; the SIG-lite covers basic controls. Ops can host in EU/UK and provide SOC2 cert link. If they insist on a local controller clause in the DPA, we can scope processing to UK region. Also can provide a redacted subprocessor list.

sam_sales: Cumulus provided PO CU-9001, VAT GB55667788, wants invoice to "Redwood Inference UK Ltd" in GBP. They asked whether a single signature on OF suffices to bind DPA and addendum. Also asked for a one-off 20% trial discount if we prepay the POC.

julia_legal: Single envelope approach fine: OF + Billing Designation Addendum + DPA signature page. I'll draft addendum: - designate Redwood Inference UK Ltd as billing party for the OF only; - link OF to MSA dated <date> (US MSA remains primary); - VAT reverse-charge language if customer confirms VIES status; - limited POC indemnity language. I'll circulate redline in #legal-drafts in 2h.

matt_finance: On discount: Finance needs an approval if >15% for POC; prepay terms require invoice as issued and then applied as credit. Treasury needs IBAN/Sort code for UK account and executed docs by Wed to process in this billing window.

noah_solutions: For SIG-lite, I'll fill in controls sections and attach SOC2 link. Ops prefers the POC to be in UK region to simplify DPA language. I'll prepare the infra confirmation and share links.

sam_sales: Routing KYC + PO now. I'll ask Cumulus whether they accept GBP invoice with reverse-charge note. Will push the discount ask to pricing.

docusign-bot: docusign-bot: Recommend single envelope: OF + Billing Designation Addendum + DPA. Customer signs first, Redwood UK signer second. Include explicit entity execution lines and "Electronic signatures binding" clause. Template: /ops/templates/uk-billing-designation-v1.docx

julia_legal: Also note: do not change governing law in addendum. Keep the US MSA governing law language intact; addendum only handles billing and limited POC carveouts.

matt_finance: Invoice-bot please create provisional invoice CU-9001 for GBP 6,800 (POC after proposed discount), status: draft. Include field for VAT reverse-charge notation pending VIES check.

invoice-bot: invoice-bot: Provisional invoice CU-9001 created (status: draft). Link: https://invoices.redwood.internal/CU-9001

sam_sales: Thanks everyone 1: pushing redlines and will update when Cumulus confirms VAT/VIES and discount.
